description: Prepend-position contract: per third_party/serve/source/main.ts:78-90, `--single` prepends `{source: '**', destination: '/index.html'}` to the user's rewrites BEFORE evaluation. The synthetic rule wins for any path the user rule would also catch, because the catch-all matches first under first-match-wins iteration (and per Stage-6e D-013 chaining the matched rule is consumed; downstream user rules then receive the rewritten path /index.html which they don't match). Anchor `extensionless_user_path_shadowed_by_single`: GET /api/42 with user rule `/api/:id → /api/handler-:id.html` and --single returns the contents of /index.html, not /api/handler-42.html. cleanUrls disabled to isolate phase-7 behavior.
